clauses.quote: Under no circumstances will the electronic communication system be used to monitor the activities in a classroom or teachers’ cafeteria without the knowledge and consent of the Teacher(s).
clauses.notes: Prohibitory effect conveyed by 'Under no circumstances' rather than explicit modal negation.

clauses.quote: In cases of emergency, phone messages for Teachers shall be delivered immediately or as soon as the Teacher can be reached.
Other telephone messages will be placed in the teachers’ mailboxes.
This message shall include the date and time of the call.
Teachers in career development centers/vocational programs who teach shop may be required to handle funds for shop work.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers in career development centers/vocational programs who teach shop
clauses.notes: Permissive modality regarding a management-imposed duty.

clauses.quote: Such teachers shall be covered against any loss of life or limb by Disability Compensation
any claim for personal property lost while handling such funds shall be processed in accordance with applicable laws.
clauses.subject_text: any claim for personal property lost while handling such funds

clauses.quote: Solicitation of teachers in any school building for contributions or donations shall be limited to announcement of opportunities for such contributions.
clauses.subject_text: Solicitation of teachers in any school building for contributions or donations

clauses.quote: Teachers shall not be required to collect money for any non-school-related organization.
clauses.notes: Relief from an otherwise implied duty.

clauses.quote: The Chancellor shall announce any emergency closing at the earliest possible time
shall submit such announcements for broadcast by local radio and television stations.
clauses.notes: Subject omitted in text but clearly continues from previous clause.

clauses.quote: All teachers shall be provided a locker, or a locker-cabinet, and a desk in each building to which the Teacher is assigned.
One of the items shall be lockable.
In the event that any Teacher places an additional lock on such property, either a duplicate key or the combination thereof shall be provided to the Supervisor.
clauses.subject_text: either a duplicate key or the combination thereof
clauses.notes: Management duty to supply keys/combos primarily serves supervisory access needs.

clauses.quote: In emergencies where the Supervisor needs to open the locked property, the Supervisor shall first seek to reach the Teacher
and obtain the consent to unlock the property.
clauses.notes: Inherited modality from preceding clause; subject implied.
